problem.observation: With one mock task running and a second pending, Agent Room displayed a persistent pending spinner; Refresh, Stop, task feedback, assignment, and model controls were disabled.

source_reproduction.red_result: failed: Room snapshot exceeded the 2-second response bound while the coordinator was executing tasks

cause: Every Agent Room snapshot called ensure_availability_watcher, which called refresh_availability. The refresh waited up to two seconds for the active coordinator lock before returning current timer data. The hot snapshot path also opened write-capable SQLite stores and reran schema setup.
change: Restore availability watchers from the already loaded report-derived timer view; do not wait for the coordinator lock during a UI snapshot.
Read the run database and optional tool-request ledger through read-only SQLite connections; an uninitialized tool-request table is treated as empty.
